'''Constantine''' is an NPC in the {{Location|Modulation Hall}}.
==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Constantine}}
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the quest [[Advance toward the Future from Today]])
:'''Constantine:''' If we keep scanning Tethys' memory, we can pinpoint the Shorekeeper's exact location.
:'''Constantine:''' We won't... ever give up on anyone.
:'''[[Jiuri]]:''' Her physical form may be lost in the Matrix, but she is still in there.
:'''Jiuri:''' Because her entire frequency spectrum is still somewhere in Tethys
:{{DIcon}}: The law of conversation?
:'''Constantine:''' Yes! Hmm... so you're familiar with this concept, it's quite significant. 
:'''Constantine:''' If we can recover her frequencies, we can use Tethys to bring her back.
:'''Jiuri:''' It'll be like finding a neelde in a haystack...
:'''Constantine:''' She believed in {{Rover}}. So, please trust us as well!
----
;(After completion of [[Beyond the Shore's End]])
:'''Constantine:''' Reporting detection result: The operational logic of Stellar Matrix "Hearth ✘ 3" has been irreversibly corrupted by abnormal frequencies.
:'''[[Morisha]]:''' Close monitoring of nearby Matriced is required. Report the Matrices closest to Hearth ✘ 3.
:'''Constantine:''' Understood. After transferring its orbit, Hearth ✘ 3 exchanged codes with Heluo RU, the closest Matrix.
:'''Constantine:''' Request access to the mechanical arm for capturing and pulling Hearth ✘ 3.
:'''Morisha:''' Copy that. Calling Error Cell. Prepare the isolation room and activate the Stellar Matrix analyzer.
:'''Morisha:''' The Probe is recommended to extract the exception code. 
{{Dialogue End}}
